purpose: One extra white-box attack after the parent's hard-label readout generalized poorly even on unprotected controls. Existing releases are immutable. Query 256 native unnormalized target class scores on the exact parent calibration indices. Fit a single existing ridge update in current direct merged student CLS features, preserving both other evaluated public heads through their joint right nullspace. No label use, optimizer, ridge tuning or coefficient search.
limits: Only the other two evaluated heads are preserved, not all seven partners. Original architecture and public heads remain unchanged. Native scores require white-box release access, not an ordinary normalized-logit black-box API. No new defense or attack novelty claim; not full SLOA. Benchmark tests and parent results already observed; this is an adaptive extra attack, not a fresh holdout.
